title: rcd.conf
description: Global configuration for rcd(8), the FreeBSD service manager

max_parallel.description: Maximum number of services starting concurrently (0 = unlimited)

control_socket.description: Path to the control UNIX socket

control_permissions.description: Permissions on the control socket. Accepts integer (0660), octal string ("0660"), or symbolic ("rw-rw----", "u=rw,g=rw")

control_group.description: Group allowed to connect to the control socket

stop_timeout_ms.description: Per-service stop timeout in milliseconds before SIGKILL

shutdown_timeout_ms.description: Global shutdown watchdog timeout in milliseconds

firstboot_sentinel.description: Path to the firstboot sentinel file
